summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco CurrencyShares Australian Dollar Trust (FXA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Australian Dollar per U.S. Dollar index. The fund tracks the changes in value of the Australian dollar (AUD) relative to the US dollar. FXA was launched on Jun 21, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.
